tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. Both siphon laws therefore predict the same behavior on the pilot. The high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost direct test for the additional loss term.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It can explain the pilot flattening but does not test whether a new loss term activates above the observed gradient range.
All five pilot gradients are below the proposed onset range, so the threshold and loss coefficient are unidentifiable.
It costs more and is less directly targeted at distinguishing the two gradient regimes.
